audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant count(is_current=true) <= 1 is enforced by a PostgreSQL partial unique index (announcements_is_current_true_idx) defined directly on the schema, making it impossible for any client or admin write to produce two rows with is_current=true — PostgreSQL raises a unique constraint violation. No application-level set-current code exists; the feature is schema-only, so there is no bypassed path.
